findings.description: The functions process_user and process_admin contain identical implementation logic, leading to unnecessary code duplication.
Code duplication detected: process_user and process_admin perform identical logic for data sanitization, violating the DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principle.

reasons: The candidate code successfully refactored the duplicated logic by centralizing it in normalize_user_data, which is then called by both process_user and process_admin.
The implementation is clean, readable, and maintains the original functionality as confirmed by the passing test suite.
The identified findings regarding code duplication are now resolved.
No new security or correctness issues were introduced.
